verifiedAttributes._comment: carrierLb / fitsWayfinder / fitsAlterrain / safety map into seed.json.
verifiedAttributes.safety: ClickTight installation, ReboundReduce stability bar (anti-rebound), side-impact protection (head/neck/torso), SafeWash fabrics, RightSize harness; 4-30 lb / 17-32"
verifiedAttributes.bobWayfinderAdapter: BOB Gear Wayfinder Universal Infant Car Seat Adapter — $59.99. The Willow / Willow S / Willow SC are explicitly named on the Wayfinder adapter compatibility list.
verifiedAttributes.bobAlterrainAdapter: native — Britax owns BOB; the Willow fits the Alterrain/Alterrain Pro via BOB's own Britax adapter (no third-party adapter needed).
verifiedAttributes.tacomaFitNotes: No direct data found for the Willow S specifically. General CPST guidance: rear-facing infant seats fit a Tacoma Access/Double Cab rear seat (Regular Cab not rated for rear-facing); front passenger seat often slides forward to make room (Toyota owner's manual + Cars.com Tacoma car-seat check).

notes: MODEL CLARIFICATION: 'Willow Brook S+' is the TRAVEL SYSTEM = Britax Willow S infant car seat (ClickTight, 4-30 lb) + Alpine anti-rebound base + Brook+ modular stroller. The standalone infant car seat is the Britax Willow S (the SC trim adds a no-rethread/extra fashion at ~$299.99-329.99). Seat-only is sold out at most retailers as of 2026-06 (~$279.99 MSRP for Willow S, ~$299.99-329.99 for Willow SC). The full Willow Brook S+ travel system IS in stock — Mega Babies $539.99 (https://www.megababiesusa.com/products/britax-willow-brook-s-travel-system) and Pottery Barn Kids (https://www.potterybarnkids.com/products/britax-willow-brook-s-plus-infant-travel-system/) — but that is a bundle, not the seat alone. Carrier-only weight ~9.2-9.3 lb (stub had 9, carrierLbVerify flag → ~9.3). Confirmed: Willow on BOB Wayfinder adapter list ($59.99) AND Britax native on Alterrain. Keep price:380 as MSRP fallback (travel-system-influenced) per SOURCING.md.
